messages.body_plain:
Dear BaSTA Users,

I have been using the BaSTA function on a old version of BaSTA (1.9.3) where models ran perfectly well. I am now trying to run the same models with exactly the same tables and setup on the latest version of BaSTA (1.9.4) on different computers but the models keeps giving me the same error message:

Calculating DIC...
Error in rep(0, nbd) : invalid 'times? argument

I?ve checked my matrix their is no NA?s.

Does anyone has an idea of what could be the problem?

Best,
Paul


Paul B?ziers
PhD Student
Department of Ecology and Evolution
Biophore Building
University of Lausanne
CH - 1015 Lausanne
SWITZERLAND
